about: FROZEN. The approved MAP-B r2.1 planning metadata (districts, hubs, buildings, landmark bases, stations, walled compounds, habitats, anchors, log targets and the study's own walk measures), the historical record of what Ammaar approved on 2026-10-03. Values are exactly the study's, in its own conventions (see convention); map-lint compares the source's planning sections with them, converting the half-open rectangles. No tool rewrites this file; map-lint checks its hash against a constant in its own code. The B1a-B1d fixtures are unchanged.
extractedFrom: tools/out/blockout/r2/candidate.py (the ignored, untracked r2.1 study): DISTRICTS, BUILDINGS, FOOT, STATIONS, WALLS, HABITATS (the control points as written), ANCHORS, TARGETS, its hubs, its log targets and its metrics. Study sha256 as in mapb-r21.json.
convention: districtsHalfOpen: [name, [x0, y0, x1, y1]] drawn from tile edge x0 to x1, so tiles x0 to x1 - 1 (half-open). buildings: [id, x0, y0, w, h, room]: tiles x0 to x0 + w - 1, y0 to y0 + h - 1. landmarkBases: [x0, y0, w, h] the same way. walls: [[x0, y0, x1, y1] inclusive (the study walked both edges), gates [x, y], why]. habitats: shapePoints (a closed smooth Hermite, 8 samples a segment) or rectHalfOpen. stations, anchors, targets, hubs, logTargets: tiles [x, y].
